description: Replicating roots that aren't lists: a map with a hundred keys, grouped writes, a failed transaction, a nested write cursor kept past its transaction, and the other kinds of root. The replica is reopened and read, and compacted, and that gets a replica of its own. Written by src/longscripts.zig.

ops.note: initializing an initialized root doesn't start a transaction
nor can it become another type
a nested write cursor can't be written to after its transaction
